audio.text: I could use a hand setting up the chairs for tonight's talk.

options: Tonight's talk starts at seven, I believe.
I used that room for my club meeting.
Give me five minutes and I'll be right over.
Yes, I'd like to give a talk someday.

why.en: Idiom: "I could use a hand" = please help me, and the correct reply offers help. A gives a time; B repeats "use" literally; D takes "talk" in another sense.
why.tr: Deyim: "I could use a hand" = yardıma ihtiyacım var; doğru cevap yardım teklif ediyor. A saat veriyor; B "use" kelimesini gerçek anlamıyla tekrar ediyor; D "talk" kelimesini başka anlamda alıyor.
why.es: Expresión: "I could use a hand" = necesito ayuda, y la respuesta correcta ofrece ayuda. A da una hora; B repite "use" en sentido literal; D toma "talk" en otro sentido.
